verdict.rationale: Pylon's own AI Reports feature lets users schedule automated summaries delivered to Slack, so the product does ship some user-configurable recurring scheduling. That scheduling is limited to one job type. Triggers are documented as workflows and automations but not as time-based, and the daily Salesforce scan is a fixed built-in sync, not something the user schedules. Missing for 10: general cron or time-based scheduling of arbitrary workflows or agent runs, evidence that triggers support recurring schedules, configurable frequency details, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: AI Reports allow you to schedule automated summaries of your data delivered directly to Slack.
